elements.text: Inadequate Southern Air Transport engine maintenance allowing oil residue accumulation in engine compressor sections
Engines becoming incapable of responding to rapid demands for increased power due to oil residue
Continuation of the go-around by the captain after power loss from two engines
Movement of the flap handle to the flaps retracted position during the go-around
Aircraft performance, two or more engines failure, partial
Go-around continued by pilot in command
Flight control system under control, movement restricted
NTSB determination of probable cause and findings
